title: Sheet-Pan Sausages and Brussels Sprouts With Honey Mustard

ingredients.name: fresh sausage
ingredients.notes: such as sweet or hot Italian sausage or bratwurst

ingredients.name: small potatoes
ingredients.notes: baby Yukon Gold or red, halved

steps.text: Heat oven to 450 degrees F with a sheet pan inside. Score sausages in a few places without cutting through. Toss sausages, Brussels sprouts and potatoes with olive oil; season with salt and pepper.
Spread on the hot sheet pan in one layer, vegetables cut-side down. Roast for 15 minutes.
Stir honey, Dijon and mustard seeds, if using, in a small bowl.

Drizzle honey mustard over sausages and vegetables and toss to coat. Flip sausages, sprinkle with nuts if using, and roast about 10 minutes more, until sausages are cooked through and vegetables are golden and tender. Season to taste.
